coordinate_convention: LSB-first: bit 0 is row 1. Reverse exactly ten bits of each primary hexadecimal column; prepend columns 1,2,4,...,512 for I_10. Do not reorder columns.
partition_convention: Every block contains one-based column POSITIONS, not column values. Zero and single-column syndromes are already represented; every other syndrome must have a two-column representation crossing distinct blocks.
scope_exclusions: No SAT solving, LRAT replay, Lean checking, or verification of the lower bound p_min >= 10.
No conclusion about a different 51-column seed or the published length-415 certificate.
No submission, external contact, or claim of human expert review.
